questions.en: Which text is not counted in 'Brihattrayi'?
questions.hi: संस्कृतसाहित्ये 'बृहत्त्रयी' अन्तर्गतः कः ग्रन्थः न गण्यते?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Brihattrayee Trayah Grantha Santhi: Kiratarjuniyam (Bharavih), Shishupalavadham (Maghah), Naishadhiyacharitam (Shriharsha) - Sutram 'Kishinai'. 'Raghuvansham' tu Laghutrayam Aagachchhati.
questions.tip: Brihattrayee = Kiratarjuniyam (18), Shishupalavadham (20), Naishadhiyacharitam (22). Laghutrayi = Raghuvansham, Kumarasambhavam, Meghdootam (Kalidassya Trayah Grantha).

questions.tip_hi: Brihattrayee = Kiratarjuniyam (18), Shishupalavadham (20), Naishadhiyacharitam (22). Laghutrayi = Raghuvansham, Kumarasambhavam, Meghdootam (Kalidassya Trayah Grantha).

questions.en: 'भारवेरर्थगौरवम्' इति प्रशंसोक्तिः कस्य कवेः कृते प्रसिद्धा? (For which poet is 'Bhāraverarthagauravam' famous?)
questions.hi: 'भारवेरर्थगौरवम्' इति प्रशंसोक्तिः कस्य कवेः कृते प्रसिद्धा? (For which poet is 'Bhāraverarthagauravam' famous?)
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: There is a famous verse: 'The beauty of similes is in Kālidāsa, the grandeur of meaning is in Bhāravi. Dandin: The elegance of words, and in the Magha, there are three qualities.' Therefore, the great poet Bharavi is famous for the grandeur of meaning.
questions.tip: Chatushtaya Guna Smrathu Kalidasah = Simile; Bharavih = Arthgauravam; Dandi = Padalalityam; Magah = Trio Sin.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
